hard_review_acceptance_gate: Evidence file and line or trace point are inspectable.
Source is named with status and authority level.
Timestamp comes from the source artifact or manifest.
high_quality_acceptance_gate: Ticker and theme align with the evidence ID.
At least one primary or authority source is workflow_verified or otherwise explicitly enabled.
The exact primary-source artifact and trace point are available, not just a summary evidence ID.
Counter-evidence or invalidation trigger is recorded.
Output stays research-only and contains no advice, trade signal, target-price advice, broker action, automatic trading, or production watchlist.
blocked_until: Raw evidence rows or source cards expose exact primary-source paths, trace points, and timestamps.
Candidate-to-enable source routes are separated from authority evidence.
Rejected score-driven cases are prevented from reappearing without new evidence IDs.
